candidates.explanation: After a successful password reset, the code only updates the user's password. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. A device that was already signed in keeps its session record, so its refresh token still passes the session lookup in refreshToken and it can renew its login. The password-change path in AuthService.update does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, but resetPassword has no equivalent call.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after the usersService.update call, add `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. This invalidates every session for the user, so all devices are signed out.
